te: Report on veterans' benefits to be revised before submission to the committee
se: The meeting considered the study report on criteria for veterans' benefits, asking for the presentation to be revised within 1 week(s) before it goes to the committee for approval
it: Study report: criteria for veterans' benefits

te: Study report on veterans' benefits adopted
se: The meeting considered follow-up matters from the previous meeting and resolved to adopt the working group's study report on criteria for veterans' benefits, in preparation for submission to the committee and the Senate
it: Study report: criteria for veterans' benefits

te: Key points of MOU -500 and MOU -499 discussed
se: The meeting noted the committee's order setting up the subcommittee's working group, the outcome of the committee's meeting on 30 June 2025, and the schedule of a study visit to the West on 17–18 July 2025. It then heard experts on the key points of the memoranda of understanding between the Government of the Kingdom of Thailand and the Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia (MOU -500 and MOU -499)
it: Order setting up the subcommittee's working group
Key points of the memoranda of understanding between the Government of the Kingdom of Thailand and the Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia (MOU -500 and MOU -499)

te: Study visit to the West prepared, and questions on the Thai–Cambodian border and the southern border
se: The meeting considered the committee's draft schedule of a study visit on military and security affairs in the West, in Kanchanaburi and Ratchaburi Provinces, in July 2025, and considered questions on the situation on the Thai–Cambodian border and in the southern border provinces for the Ministry of Defence, the Office of the National Security Council and ISOC, for submission to the committee. It also considered the work of the working groups
it: Draft schedule of the study visit on military and security affairs in the West
Questions on the situation on the Thai–Cambodian border and in the southern border provinces
Results of the working groups' work

te: The Territorial Defence Command gives information on producing reserve forces from reserve officer training students
se: The meeting invited the agencies concerned to give information on producing the armed forces' main reserve forces from reserve officer training students, training courses in the central region, the regions and the southern border provinces, initiatives of the Territorial Defence Command, problems and solutions, and noted the working groups' plans, such as discussions with the Thailand Professional Qualification Institute on creating careers for conscripts after discharge
it: Producing reserve forces from reserve officer training students
Work plans of the subcommittee's working groups

te: Meeting 13/2568 · Subcommittee on Military Affairs (2024–2025 term)
Approaches to supporting research budgets for the defence industry noted
se: The meeting noted the outcome of the committee's meeting on 30 April 2025, at which the armed services agreed to push for the Defence Science and Technology Department to become a programme management unit (PMU) for security, to integrate research budgets into the defence industry, and to speed up preparation of a draft Military Equipment Standards Act
it: Approaches to pushing for and supporting budgets to develop the defence industry (outcome of the committee's meeting)

te: Outcomes of meetings of 2 ad hoc committees noted
se: The meeting noted the outcome of the first meeting of the Senate ad hoc committee considering the draft Defence Civil Servants' Salaries and Position Allowances Act B.E. ...., which set a consideration period of 60 days ending on 24 August 2025, and the outcome of the meeting of the Senate ad hoc committee studying the opening of entertainment complexes
it: Outcome of the meeting of the ad hoc committee considering the draft Defence Civil Servants' Salaries and Position Allowances Act B.E. ....
Outcome of the meeting of the ad hoc committee studying the opening of entertainment complexes

te: Committee approves the draft report on veterans' benefits
se: The meeting noted that the committee had approved the draft study report on developing criteria for veterans' benefits, approved the appointment of an additional special working group, approved in principle the subcommittee observing the selection of men for conscription in Nonthaburi Province, and noted the committee's presentation of its work
it: Draft study report: developing criteria for veterans' benefits
Observing the selection of men for conscription, Nonthaburi Province

te: Work report prepared for presentation to the Senate on 1 April 2025
se: The meeting prepared the subcommittee's part of the committee's work report (September 2024 – March 2025) for presentation to the Senate on 1 April 2025, prepared to present its study of the draft Defence Civil Servants' Salaries and Position Allowances Act B.E. .... as assigned, and sped up its study reports for the committee to place on the Senate agenda
it: Presentation of the work report for September 2024 – March 2025 to the Senate
Presentation of the study of the draft Defence Civil Servants' Salaries and Position Allowances Act B.E. ....
The subcommittee's study reports

te: Armed forces structure working group proposes approaches to developing conscripts
se: The meeting noted the schedule of the committee's study visit on security in the West and approved the proposal of the armed forces structure working group that a sub-group hold discussions with Muban Chom Bueng Rajabhat University, Ratchaburi Province, on developing personnel through education, and coordinate with the Army Personnel Department on developing conscripts, such as the results of the project for recruiting men liable for service
it: Schedule of the committee's study visit on security in the West
Proposals of the armed forces structure working group on developing conscripts

te: Observations given on the draft law on defence civil servants' salaries
se: The meeting noted the postponement of the study visit to the 9th Infantry Division, Surasi Camp, Kanchanaburi Province, and considered the study report on the draft Defence Civil Servants' Salaries and Position Allowances Act B.E. .... as assigned, giving views, observations and recommendations for submission to the committee
it: Postponement of the study visit to Surasi Camp, Kanchanaburi Province
Report on the study of the draft Defence Civil Servants' Salaries and Position Allowances Act B.E. ....

te: Veterans' requests concerning the honour allowance followed up
se: The meeting noted the outcome of joining a meeting of the Committee on Labour on developing the skills of Thai workers in Japan, and noted that the Chair had assigned representatives of the subcommittee to receive a submission from a group of veterans at the People's Square in front of Parliament on 24 February 2025, proposing a draft Act on the Honour Allowance for Veterans holding class 2, 3 and 4 cards, and will follow up the matter
it: Outcome of joining the Committee on Labour's meeting on developing the skills of Thai workers in Japan
Proposal from a group of veterans for a draft Act on the Honour Allowance for Veterans

te: Discussions with the Chinese side on disaster relief cooperation followed up
se: The meeting considered the outcome of discussions with the Chinese Defence Attaché on 24 January 2025. The Chinese side accepted an invitation to visit the disaster relief training centre in Chachoengsao Province and will invite the Commander of the Armed Forces Development Command to visit China to see equipment and disaster rescue training centres, and to discuss joint training, disaster relief and military medicine
it: Follow-up from discussions with the Chinese Defence Attaché: cooperation on disaster rescue and military medicine

te: Follow-up of reserve officer training and a study visit to border crossings in Kanchanaburi prepared
se: The meeting considered the schedule for following the field training of reserve officer training students at the Reserve Officer Training Camp, Khao Chon Kai, Kanchanaburi Province, a study visit to military units and border crossings in Kanchanaburi Province in March 2025, and inviting representatives of the Comptroller General's Department and the War Veterans Organization of Thailand to give information
it: Following the field training of reserve officer training students, Khao Chon Kai Camp
Study visit to military units and border crossings, Kanchanaburi Province
Inviting the Comptroller General's Department and the War Veterans Organization of Thailand to give information

te: Setting up of a working group to study the national security structure noted
se: The meeting noted the outcome of the committee's meeting, which approved setting up a working group to study the report proposing a structure and framework for a study to develop Thailand's national security and military affairs, and noted tasks assigned by the Chair of the committee
it: Outcome of the committee's meeting: working group set up to study proposals on the structure of national security and military affairs
